title: Is possible to monetize an Ai game?
author: NickG031st
selftext:
Hi there, this is my first post here.

Starting from the beginning, my company is going to close in about 8 months, so I've had plenty of free time on my hands. During this time, I decided to develop an Android game using vibe coding, since I don't know much about programming.

I work as a design engineer, mainly doing technical drawings, 3D models, and similar things.

It started as a hobby and a childhood dream of making my own game. To be honest, I never thought I would actually see it released on Google Play, but now that it's finally done, I'm wondering if there's any way to monetize it. Maybe find a publisher or something?

I'd appreciate any advice or suggestions!
